test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 26 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Veteran classical dance guru from ______, Jatin Goswami was given the National Kalidas Samman for 2017.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Assam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jatin Goswami**

 
 
• A well-known **veteran classical dancer from Assam is Jatin Goswami**.
 
• In **1933**, Jatin Goswami was** born in Dergaon, Upper Assam**.
 
• Jatin Goswami began his **first lesson of Satriya dance at home with the help of his father**.
 
• Later, he received **expert gurus' instruction in dance and music** on the Vaishnava Satras.
 
• In order **to** **advance and expand the Satriya dancing style**, **he also founded a dance group**.
 
• In **1962**, the **Kalaguru Bishnu Prasad Rabha and Roseswar Saikia Borbayan** collaborated to** form the **dancing group known as **Pragati Kala Parishad**.
 
• Jatin Goswami has **received numerous recommendations and titles**.
 
• During the** Khajuraho Dance Festival, Jatin Goswami was given the National Kalidas Samman**, Madhya Pradesh's most prestigious cultural award, for **2017**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Sankari Sangeet Vidyapeeth presented Jatin Goswami **with the **Nritya Acharya Samman in 1999**.
 
• In **1994**, he received the **Silpi Divas Award**, and in **1995–1996** he received the **Assam Natya Samiti Mobile Theatre Award**.
 
• As a result of his **significant creative effort and his contributions to Satriya dance and music**, he was also given the **Padma Shri Award in 2008**.
 
• **In 2018, renowned Kathak dancer Guru Uma Sharma was given the National Kalidas Samman**, Madhya Pradesh's most prestigious cultural honour during the Khajuraho Dance Festival.
 
• The prize consists of a **plaque and Rs 2 lakh**.
